Colombo.name: Viharamahadevi Park
Colombo.fee: Free for general, LKR 2,000 for commercial/wedding shoots
Colombo.notes: Prior permission required for large setups and lighting gear.

Colombo.name: Independence Square
Colombo.notes: No drones allowed. Great for architectural backgrounds and elegant portraits.

Colombo.name: Galle Face Green
Colombo.notes: Perfect for dramatic sunset silhouettes. Gets heavily crowded on weekends.

Colombo.name: Port City Colombo
Colombo.fee: Free for casual, commercial permit required for large crews
Colombo.notes: Strict security checks. Drones require special prior approval.

Colombo.name: Seema Malakaya & Beira Lake
Colombo.notes: Beautiful morning light with an urban temple aesthetic. Needs to be respectful of the religious site.

Malabe.name: Water's Edge Boardwalk
Malabe.notes: Perfect for sunset golden hour. Needs advance booking and confirmation.

Malabe.name: Ape Gama
Malabe.notes: Ideal for traditional, rustic, or vintage themed pre-shoots.

Kaduwela.name: Diyatha Uyana
Kaduwela.notes: Gets crowded in the evening. Morning shoots are highly recommended for clear backgrounds.

Kaduwela.name: Beddagana Wetland Park
Kaduwela.notes: Wooden pathways and natural greenery. Drones are strictly prohibited due to birdlife.

Matara.name: Pigeon Island Bridge
Matara.notes: Windy location, great for dramatic sunset fill light.

Matara.name: Polhena Beach
Matara.notes: Clear shallow waters. Morning is best to avoid the local crowds.

Galle.name: Galle Dutch Fort
Galle.notes: Iconic colonial architecture and ramparts. Drone flying requires strict civil aviation and police clearance.

Galle.name: Unawatuna Beach
Galle.notes: Best in the early morning for uninterrupted shots. Famous for the palm tree swings (swing owners may charge a small fee).

Kandy.name: Royal Botanical Gardens, Peradeniya
Kandy.notes: Huge variety of backdrops including the palm avenue. Advance booking recommended for full crews.

Kandy.name: Kandy Lake Round
Kandy.notes: Beautiful backdrop of the Temple of the Tooth. Traffic gets heavy later in the day.

Nuwara Eliya.name: Lake Gregory
Nuwara Eliya.notes: Misty mornings provide a cinematic, cool vibe. Can be crowded during public holidays.

Nuwara Eliya.name: Hakgala Botanical Garden
Nuwara Eliya.notes: Beautiful rose garden and temperate plants. Weather can be unpredictable, bring rain protection for gear.
